names: Deadlift day — barbell DL + accessories, 8,970 kg
Hack squat day — hack squat + accessories, 15,206 kg

en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 15 – Aug 21 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~524 kcal/day against ~631 last window. Saturday's Zagreb hike (aging out of most other charts but still counted here) put 1,586 active kcal on the board, Thursday's hack squat day added 741, Monday's deadlift day 613, Tuesday's pool swim 626, Sunday and Wednesday were true rest days at 41 and 62, and today reads 0 — nothing recorded yet this morning.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 68 because the day just started). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −938 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Saturday alone implies ≈ −2,000. Today (Aug 21) has barely started.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Two lifting days push volume well past last window's total
en.i1: 4 sessions across 4 active days, 8h 12m and ~3,669 active kcal — against 7 sessions, 8h 30m and ~4,414 kcal in the Aug 10–16 window. Fewer sessions, close to the same total time, but tonnage jumped to 24,176 kg from 9,670 kg because two separate lifting days landed inside this window instead of one. Saturday's Zagreb hike is still on the board at the back of the window — 4h 27m, 16.5 km, 573 m of climbing, avg HR 109, max 154, 1,912 active kcal — unchanged from last refresh, it has just aged one slot further back. Sunday was a clean rest day (41 active kcal, max HR 112). Tuesday brought a 2,225 m pool swim, 67 minutes, avg HR 130, max 152, 794 kcal. Wednesday was rest again (62 kcal, max HR 102). Today is empty so far.
en.i2t: First deadlift session logged in weeks, plus the heaviest tonnage day on the board
en.i2: Monday 12:34–13:46 — 84 minutes (Garmin), 668 active kcal, avg HR 112, max 145. Nineteen sets, 243 reps, 8,970 kg: barbell deadlift 70×6, 90×6, 110×3, then three work sets at 120×8, followed by walking lunges, dumbbell overhead press, seated cable row and incline bench press. This is a straight barbell deadlift, not the trap-bar variant the plan is chasing, so that dry spell keeps running — last trap-bar entry was Jun 20, now 62 days back. Thursday 10:16–11:25 — 74 minutes (Garmin) / 69 minutes (Hevy), 737 active kcal, avg HR 123, max 155. Twenty sets, 206 reps, 15,206 kg — more tonnage than any other single day visible in this log, past Aug 13's 9,670 kg. Hack squat ramped 60×6, 100×6, 140×3, then three work sets at 160×12 with RPE climbing to 9.5, followed by lying leg curl, barbell bench press, lat pulldown and seated shoulder press. This closes the hack-squat gap that had reached 23 days (last one Jul 28): the per-set HR chart gets a new point — six sets, peaks an estimated 117, 123, 130, 140, 136 and 151 bpm, average 120 across the block. The estimate anchors on a clean trough (81 bpm around the 12-minute mark) but the six peaks come from binning the stream rather than matching individual sets, so it is flagged uncertain. Goblet squat remains untouched since Jun 11, now 71 days.
en.i3t: Hevy and Intervals synced clean; Garmin has not posted last night's sleep yet
en.i3: Hevy returned both lifting sessions with full set-by-set data — Monday's 8,970 kg and Thursday's 15,206 kg are both measured, not estimated. Intervals.icu synced but had nothing new to add this window. Garmin's full sync ran to completion (17 endpoints) and covers activity and sleep data through calendar date Aug 20 — but there is no sleep record yet for calendar date Aug 21, meaning last night (Thursday evening into this morning) has not posted. Today's Body Battery shows just 1 point charged and 0 drained so far, far below a normal morning reading, which lines up with the missing sleep record rather than a real accounting of the night. The seven recorded nights on the sleep chart (Aug 13–19 evenings) have no gaps.
en.i4t: Recovery: last night is untracked — Wednesday's night is the latest reading
en.i4: There is no Garmin sleep record for last night (Aug 20 evening into this morning) as of this refresh. The most recent recorded night, Wednesday into Thursday, scored 79 (fair) on 7h 33m, down 4 from Tuesday's 83 but 59 minutes over the 6h 34m average. HRV read 34, six under the 40 average and the softest reading of the window; RHR held at 54, level with the average and part of a real improving trend since Aug 17 (53–54 every night, versus 55 the whole previous window). That RHR drop is exactly what last refresh's easy-day advice was chasing.
en.rec: The plan called for rebuilding toward trap-bar DL / hack squat and logging a tracked lift — Thursday's hack squat session does exactly that, and at 15,206 kg it is the heaviest tonnage day on the board. Monday's deadlift was a plain barbell pull, not trap-bar, so that half of the plan is still open. Last night has not synced in Garmin yet, so there is no fresh recovery reading to lean on this morning; the last confirmed one, Wednesday into Thursday, was a fair 79 with HRV on the soft side (34, six under average) and the week's highest stress reading (37). Thursday's hack squat session — three work sets at 160×12, RPE climbing to 9.5 — is real fatigue in the legs and hips regardless of what last night's untracked data would have shown. This is not the day for trap-bar deadlift: give the posterior chain at least 48 hours before loading it again. A short mobility session or an easy pace fits better today, with the trap-bar attempt pushed to the weekend once Garmin confirms a couple of full nights of recovery. Keep logging every set in Hevy so the per-set HR chart keeps getting clean, matched data instead of estimates like today's hack-squat entry. Next: easy or off today, trap-bar DL once recovery data is back, log every set.

hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 15.–21.8. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosječno ~524 kcal/dan naspram ~631 prethodnog prozora. Subotnje planinarenje po Zagrebu (izlazi iz većine drugih grafova, ali se ovdje još broji) upisalo je 1.586 aktivnih kcal, četvrtkov dan hack čučnja dodao je 741, ponedjeljkov dan mrtvog dizanja 613, utorkovo plivanje u bazenu 626, nedjelja i srijeda bili su pravi dani odmora sa 41 i 62, a danas piše 0 — jutros još ništa nije zabilježeno.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 68 jer je dan tek počeo). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −938 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, ne mjerena. Sama subota implicira ≈ −2.000. Danas (21.8.) tek je počelo.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Dva dana dizanja guraju tonažu daleko iznad prošlog prozora
hr.i1: 4 treninga kroz 4 aktivna dana, 8h 12m i ~3.669 aktivnih kcal — naspram 7 treninga, 8h 30m i ~4.414 kcal u prozoru 10.–16.8. Manje treninga, gotovo isto ukupno vrijeme, ali tonaža je skočila na 24.176 kg s 9.670 kg jer su u ovaj prozor upala dva odvojena dana dizanja umjesto jednog. Subotnje planinarenje po Zagrebu i dalje je na ploči na stražnjem kraju prozora — 4h 27m, 16,5 km, 573 m uspona, prosječni puls 109, maksimum 154, 1.912 aktivnih kcal — nepromijenjeno od prošlog osvježavanja, samo je jedno mjesto starije. Nedjelja je bila čist dan odmora (41 aktivnih kcal, maksimalni puls 112). Utorak je donio plivanje od 2.225 m u bazenu, 67 minuta, prosječni puls 130, maksimum 152, 794 kcal. Srijeda je opet bila odmor (62 kcal, maksimalni puls 102). Danas je zasad prazno.
hr.i2t: Prvi trening mrtvog dizanja nakon tjedana pauze, plus najveći dan tonaže na ploči
hr.i2: Ponedjeljak od 12:34 do 13:46 — 84 minute (Garmin), 668 aktivnih kcal, prosjek 112, maksimum 145. Devetnaest serija, 243 ponavljanja, 8.970 kg: mrtvo dizanje s olimpijskom šipkom 70×6, 90×6, 110×3, pa tri radne serije na 120×8, potom hodajući iskoraci, potisak s bučicama iznad glave, veslanje na kabelu sjedeći i kosi potisak s bučicama. Ovo je obično mrtvo dizanje sa šipkom, ne trap-bar varijanta koju plan traži, pa ta suša i dalje traje — zadnji trap-bar unos bio je 20.6., sada 62 dana unatrag. Četvrtak od 10:16 do 11:25 — 74 minute (Garmin) / 69 minuta (Hevy), 737 aktivnih kcal, prosjek 123, maksimum 155. Dvadeset serija, 206 ponavljanja, 15.206 kg — više tonaže nego ijedan drugi pojedinačni dan vidljiv u ovom zapisu, ispred 9.670 kg od 13.8. Hack čučanj je rastao 60×6, 100×6, 140×3, pa tri radne serije na 160×12 uz RPE do 9,5, potom pregib potkoljenice ležeći, potisak za prsa sa šipkom, povlačenje na lat mašini i potisak za ramena sjedeći. Time se zatvara pauza u hack čučnju koja je narasla na 23 dana (zadnji 28.7.): graf pulsa po serijama dobiva novu točku — šest serija, procijenjeni vrhovi 117, 123, 130, 140, 136 i 151 otkucaja, prosjek 120 kroz blok. Procjena se oslanja na čisti minimum (81 otkucaj oko dvanaeste minute), ali šest vrhova dolazi iz grupiranja niza, a ne iz podudaranja pojedinačnih serija, pa je označeno kao nesigurno. Goblet čučanj i dalje čeka od 11.6., sada 71 dan.
hr.i3t: Hevy i Intervals sinkronizirani čisto; Garmin još nije objavio sinoćnji san
hr.i3: Hevy je vratio oba treninga dizanja s potpunim podacima po serijama — ponedjeljkovih 8.970 kg i četvrtkovih 15.206 kg oboje su izmjereni, ne procijenjeni. Intervals.icu se sinkronizirao, ali nije donio ništa novo ovaj prozor. Garminova puna sinkronizacija završena je do kraja (17 krajnjih točaka) i pokriva aktivnost i san do kalendarskog datuma 20.8. — no za kalendarski datum 21.8. još nema zapisa sna, što znači da sinoćnja noć (četvrtak navečer do jutros) još nije objavljena. Jutrošnji Body Battery pokazuje tek 1 bod napunjen i 0 potrošen, daleko ispod uobičajenog jutarnjeg očitanja, što se poklapa s nedostajućim zapisom sna, a ne sa stvarnim mjerenjem noći. Sedam zabilježenih noći na grafu sna (večeri 13.–19.8.) nemaju praznina.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: sinoćnja noć nije praćena — srijedina noć je zadnje očitanje
hr.i4: Za sinoć (večer 20.8. do jutros) ne postoji Garminov zapis sna u trenutku ovog osvježavanja. Zadnja zabilježena noć, srijeda na četvrtak, ocijenjena je 79 (osrednje) uz 7h 33m, četiri manje od utorkovih 83, ali 59 minuta iznad prosjeka od 6h 34m. HRV je iznosio 34, šest ispod prosjeka od 40 i najslabije očitanje u prozoru; RHR je ostao na 54, isto kao prosjek, i dio je stvarnog trenda poboljšanja od 17.8. (53–54 svake noći, naspram 55 cijeli prethodni prozor). Taj pad RHR-a upravo je ono što je tražio savjet o lakšem danu iz prošlog osvježavanja.
hr.rec: Plan je tražio izgradnju prema trap-bar DL / hack čučnju i bilježenje praćenog podizanja — četvrtkov trening hack čučnja to točno i radi, a s 15.206 kg najveći je dan tonaže na ploči. Ponedjeljkovo mrtvo dizanje bilo je obično dizanje sa šipkom, ne trap-bar, pa je ta polovica plana i dalje otvorena. Sinoćnja noć još se nije sinkronizirala u Garminu, pa jutros nema svježeg očitanja oporavka na koje bi se oslonio; zadnje potvrđeno, srijeda na četvrtak, bilo je osrednjih 79 uz HRV na mekšoj strani (34, šest ispod prosjeka) i najviši stres tjedna (37). Četvrtkov trening hack čučnja — tri radne serije na 160×12 uz RPE do 9,5 — stvaran je umor u nogama i kukovima bez obzira na to što bi sinoćnji nepraćeni podatak pokazao. Danas nije dan za trap-bar mrtvo dizanje: daj stražnjem lancu barem 48 sati prije nego ga ponovno opteretiš. Kratak trening mobilnosti ili laganо tempo bolje pristaju danas, a pokušaj trap-bara pomakni na vikend, kad Garmin potvrdi par punih noći oporavka. Nastavi bilježiti svaku seriju u Hevyju kako bi graf pulsa po serijama i dalje dobivao čiste, podudarne podatke umjesto procjena poput današnjeg unosa za hack čučanj. Sljedeće: lagano ili slobodno danas, trap-bar DL kad se oporavak vrati u podatke, bilježi svaku seriju.
